name: westland
description: Westland organizational plugin — safety hooks, house-style references, bug-report capture, and the Westland MCP connector config. Install first; required dependency of domain plugins. Contains the Westland Project Files PreToolUse hook (modify-prompt on existing files; .xer in-place changes/deletes denied; .html/.md/.json allowlisted), the westland-house-style skill, the westland-bug-report skill (Procore-gated bug capture to Supabase via the Westland MCP connector), and ships .mcp.json declaring the unified Westland MCP connector (/westland/mcp).
